statement: Cross-project UIGS web capture orchestration must not infer that a Node project has a lockfile or supports npm ci/cache solely from its package manager; install/cache strategy must come from an explicit source contract or observed repository files.

scope.notes: Scoped to project installation/cache strategy discovery.

review.rationale: Conservative migration from validated legacy record BUG.UIGS.WEB_CAPTURE.LOCKFILE_ASSUMPTION; statement is bounded to the failure mode and remediation already evidenced by that record.
